resources.string: Wireless Android Auto on your bike\'s dash (Carbit/EasyConnect dashes), with fixes and extras for the Zontes 125X / ZT125T-X. Based on OpenCfMoto.
Questions, logs or a new bike? Open an issue on GitHub or ask in the group. Donations help cover the costs.

RideScreen AA is maintained by Manel (mgb1982). It is a derivative of OpenCfMoto, © 2026 Alexandru (zanderp), and like it, free software under the GNU AGPL v3 or later: see LICENSE and NOTICE in the repository.

• Manel (mgb1982) — RideScreen AA: dash clock fix, Wear OS app, new design, ride extras
• Alexandru (zanderp) — OpenCfMoto, the app this is built on

OpenCfMoto itself builds on the open-cfmoto community:
• dcoletto / coletz — original QR & EasyConn work
• BojanJ — Android Auto receiver integration
• richardbizik — 1000 MT‑X support
• ionutradu252 / open-cflink — handlebar controls, margins, reconnect & polish
• eugen0309 — Wi‑Fi Direct / CL‑C450 path
• Martin Escudero (martinescudero) — Android Auto 17.4+ head unit server path
• Glifaus — Wi‑Fi Direct keep-alive
• sashop2001 — AA DPI, Bluetooth trigger, Bulgarian
• Authoritt — vehicle telemetry field notes
• headunit-revived — Android Auto projection stack (AGPL)

And everyone who tested bikes, shared logs, and filed issues.
